channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: CT Firefighter Injured Battling Two-Alarm Fire That Displaced Seven
item.description: A firefighter was injured while battling a two-alarm fire in New Haven that displaced seven residents.

item.title: China Bans Tesla-Style Doors Because They’re a Public Safety Hazard
item.description: China has banned Tesla-style concealed door handles due to safety concerns after multiple fatalities. New regulations require mechanical releases for all cars sold, effective January 1, 2027.

item.title: NY Inventor Set to Test ‘STELLA Snow Rescue Sled’
item.description: The STELLA Snow Rescue Sled, designed by inventor Dan Tuller, will be tested in Lake George on Feb. 7 to enhance emergency responses during severe winter weather.

item.title: MA Woman Dies in Fire at House With No Working Smoke Alarms
item.description: A Pittsfield woman, 76-year-old Noreen Reu, died in a house fire that lacked working smoke alarms.

item.title: Three Dead, One Injured After TX House Fire
item.description: Three people died and one was injured in a house fire in Weatherford early Saturday. The cause is under investigation by the Parker County fire marshal’s office.

item.title: CT Transformer Explosion Knocks out Power, Sends Man to Hospital
item.description: A transformer explosion in Hartford caused power outages for about 1,250 residents and sent one person to the hospital. The incident is under investigation by local authorities.

item.title: Explosion Destroys NH Mental Health Facility; Three Firefighters Injured in Mayday
item.description: An explosion at a mental health facility in Nashua caused a four-alarm fire, injuring three firefighters. The building was destroyed, but all 40 employees escaped uninjured.

item.title: Black History Month: Lessons from Frederick Douglass for Today’s Challenges
item.description: "The culture is so strong that it dares a person to say something." Larry Conley, joined by David Conley, on personal leadership and growth in the context of Frederick Douglass's legacy and determination.

item.title: Common Errors in Live Fire Training
item.description: Ian Bennett of West Coast Fire Training reviews three common errors students make when undertaking live fire training.

item.title: One In Every 100: Our Fire Problem Recalibrated
item.description: The mission of the fire service has always been to save lives and property. Brian Brush examines some recent data that raises questions about how we measure fireground success.
